milestones.label: Application deadline (set by each Taiwan representative office), 2026 call
milestones.time_text: 31 March to 1 May 2026, depending on the office
milestones.source_text: Official 2026 guidelines from Taiwan's overseas offices show different postmark deadlines: 31 March 2026 at the Taipei office in Finland, 24 April at New York and 1 May for Ireland. Universities in Taiwan set their own separate admission deadlines. A 2027 call had not been announced when checked.
